name: 发布工作台
description: 把笔记库里的母稿渲染成全 inline 化的 HTML 一键送进剪贴板 —— 公众号编辑器会丢弃 class 与外联样式表,只有元素上的 style 属性能活下来,markdown 直接粘过去必崩;发之前再做一次本地体检,点名 mermaid / 公式 / 裸 HTML / 外链图片 / 表格等到了公众号会失效的块,并给出手工处理指引。数据流向:母稿取自你当前打开的笔记或工作文件夹里的固定草稿,渲染 / 体检 / 中英盘古之白全部在本地完成不联网;发布记录写成你笔记库里的纯 Markdown 台账(<工作文件夹>/Ledger/YYYY-MM.md);仅当你主动点「AI 助手」时,才把母稿或体检命中列表发给你已登录的 Forsion 后端,不经任何第三方服务;插件不会自动发布、不调用公众号接口。
descriptionEn: Renders your markdown source into fully inlined HTML and puts it on the clipboard in one click — the WeChat Official Account editor drops class attributes and external style sheets, so raw markdown always breaks when pasted. Before you publish, a local pre-flight check names the blocks that will fail there (mermaid, math, raw HTML, remote images, tables …) and tells you how to fix each by hand. Data flow: the source is your active note or a fixed draft file in the plugin work folder; rendering, checking and CJK/Latin spacing all run locally and offline; publish records are written as plain Markdown in your own vault (<work folder>/Ledger/YYYY-MM.md). Only when you press the AI assistant does the source (or the findings list) go to your signed-in Forsion backend — never to a third party. The plugin never publishes for you and never calls WeChat APIs.

onboarding.intro: 公众号编辑器会剥掉 class 与外联 CSS,母稿直接粘过去必崩。发布工作台把它渲染成全 inline 化的 HTML,一键进剪贴板,粘上去就是排好版的;并在发之前做一次本地体检,点名哪些块到了公众号会失效。

steps.title: 选母稿
steps.description: 命令面板「发布工作台:打开」。默认吃你当前打开的那篇笔记(顶部显示它的路径,frontmatter 与块标记行会自动剥掉);没有打开的笔记就切到「草稿」,在左栏直接写,失焦自动存到 <工作文件夹>/草稿.md。

steps.title: 看预览
steps.description: 右栏那张白纸卡就是公众号里的样子 —— 深浅模式下它都是白纸,因为它模拟的是公众号页面,不是插件界面。正文字号 / 行高 / 排版风格在插件设置里改。

steps.title: 发布前体检
steps.description: 底栏摘要条给出「几项阻断 · 几项警告」,点开看逐条命中:mermaid 与公式要自己截图上传,裸 HTML 会被整段剥掉,外链图片要在公众号编辑器里手工上传,外链正文里只会剩文字。点条目跳到左栏对应行。体检是纯本地规则,离线可用。

steps.title: 复制到公众号
steps.description: 点「复制到公众号」→ 打开公众号编辑器 → Ctrl/Cmd+V。剪贴板不可用时会自动退回导出 <工作文件夹>/Exports/*.html,用浏览器打开后全选复制同样能用。

steps.title: 台账
steps.description: 每次复制 / 导出都会往 <工作文件夹>/Ledger/YYYY-MM.md 追加一条(纯 Markdown,可以在笔记里直接打开手改)。命令「发布工作台:打开台账」看本月清单,发完把链接填回去标记「已发布」。

steps.title: AI 助手(可选)
steps.description: 工具条的「AI 助手」用你已登录的 Forsion 后端做四件事:起标题 / 写摘要(≤120 字)/ 改写语气 / 把体检命中翻译成人话步骤。没登录时按钮置灰,其余功能完全不受影响。

en.intro: The WeChat editor strips class attributes and external CSS, so pasted markdown always breaks. Publisher renders your source into fully inlined HTML, puts it on the clipboard ready to paste, and runs a local pre-flight check that names the blocks which will fail there.

steps.title: Pick a source
steps.description: Command palette → "Publisher: Open". It reads the note you currently have open (its path is shown at the top; frontmatter and host block markers are stripped automatically). With no note open, switch to Draft and write in the left pane — it is saved to <work folder>/草稿.md when the box loses focus.

steps.title: Watch the preview
steps.description: The white sheet on the right is what WeChat will show. It stays white paper in both light and dark mode because it simulates the WeChat page, not the plugin UI. Body size, line height and article style live in the plugin settings.

steps.title: Pre-flight check
steps.description: The bar at the bottom shows how many blocking items and warnings you have; open it for the list. Mermaid and math need a screenshot, raw HTML is stripped wholesale, remote images must be uploaded by hand in the WeChat editor, and links in the body keep only their text. Click an item to jump to that line. The check is pure local rules and works offline.

steps.title: Copy for WeChat
steps.description: Press "Copy for WeChat", open the WeChat editor, paste with Ctrl/Cmd+V. If the clipboard is unavailable the plugin falls back to exporting <work folder>/Exports/*.html — open it in a browser, select all, copy.

steps.title: Ledger
steps.description: Every copy or export appends one entry to <work folder>/Ledger/YYYY-MM.md (plain Markdown you can open and edit as a note). "Publisher: Open ledger" shows the month; paste the published URL back to mark an entry as published.

steps.title: AI assistant (optional)
steps.description: The AI assistant uses your signed-in Forsion backend for four jobs: title ideas, a ≤120-character abstract, tone rewrites, and turning the findings list into concrete manual steps. Without a sign-in the button is greyed out and everything else keeps working.
